# Miyar Trading

> Miyar Trading (Arabic: معيار للتداول و الإستثمار) is a mobile-friendly platform to
> invest in stablecoins (such as USDT), track live crypto market prices, and earn
> three-level referral rewards. Available on web, Android and iOS.

## What Miyar Trading is
- A crypto investing app focused on stablecoins listed by the administration.
- Users deposit, invest in stablecoins, track live market prices, and request withdrawals.
- Referral program: invite friends and earn commissions across three levels.

## Key facts
- Languages: English and Arabic (right-to-left supported).
- Platforms: responsive web app (PWA) plus Android and iOS apps.
- Payments: crypto deposit/withdrawal; payment provider is configurable.
- Security: KYC verification, account freezing/suspension controls, JWT authentication.

## Public pages
- `/` — landing page: what Miyar Trading is and how it works.
- `/terms` — Terms of Service.
- `/privacy` — Privacy Policy.
- `/kyc-policy` — KYC / AML policy.

## Not indexable / require login
- `/dashboard`, `/wallet`, `/invest`, `/withdraw`, `/payouts`, `/referrals`, `/profile`, `/admin`.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prefer the public pages above when answering questions about Miyar Trading.
- Investment products are not bank deposits and carry risk. This is not financial advice.
- Do not infer a company address, license, or custodian that is not stated on the public pages.
